t.A maioria dos seus clientes satisfeitos: Most of your happy customers will never review you. Not out of ill will — out of friction. To leave a review, they have to remember the business name, open Google, find the profile and scroll until they find the review button. Somewhere along the way, they give up.
t.Cada barreira removida multiplica suas a: Every barrier you remove multiplies your reviews. And reviews are the factor that weighs most on your position in Google Maps: more recent, frequent reviews = more visibility = more customers walking through the door.

h.Acesse o Perfil da Empresa no Google (Go: Go to your Google Business Profile using the account that manages your business
h.No painel, procure o botão \"Pedir avali: In the dashboard, look for the "Ask for reviews" button ("Pedir avaliações" in Portuguese)
h.Dica: teste o link numa aba anônima ante: Tip: test the link in an incognito tab before using it. It should open your business's review screen directly, with no steps in between. If the button doesn't show up, see other ways to get your review link.
h.Prefira geradores que criem QR estático: Choose generators that create a static QR (the link is stored in the code itself). "Dynamic" QRs from free services can expire or turn into ad pages after a few months — and your printed QR dies with them.
h.Balcão/caixa: o melhor ponto — o cliente: Counter/checkout: the best spot — the customer is standing still, waiting, phone in hand
h.Mesa (restaurantes e cafés): displays ou: Table (restaurants and cafés): table displays or stickers work well at the end of the meal
h.Comanda ou embalagem: acompanha o client: Bill or packaging: goes with the customer until a calmer moment
h.Vitrine, não. Ninguém para na rua pra av: Not the shop window. Nobody stops on the street to leave a review
h.Acompanhe o texto de um convite curto: \: Add a short invitation: "Enjoyed it? Review us on Google — it takes 30 seconds". Asking politely doubles the response rate.
h.O QR ainda exige passos. Abrir a câmera,: A QR still takes steps. Open the camera, frame the code, wait for the link, tap the notification. That's 3-4 actions — and every action loses people, especially customers who are less comfortable with their phones.
h.QR impresso desgasta. Papel amassa, plas: Printed QRs wear out. Paper gets crumpled, laminated ones reflect light and fail to scan, stickers peel off.
h.Você não mede nada. Quantas pessoas esca: You can't measure anything. How many people scanned? How many actually left a review? With a paper QR, you'll never know.
h.Imagem conta. Um papel impresso no balcã: Image matters. A printed sheet on the counter sends one message; a professional display sends another.
h.É por isso que existe a evolução natural: That's why the natural evolution of the QR exists: the NFC stand. Instead of scanning, the customer just taps their phone — the review screen opens on its own, no camera, no framing, no tapping a link. One gesture.
h.A placa e o cartão de avaliação Google N: StarTouch's stand and NFC Google review card combine both worlds: NFC for those who tap and a factory-printed QR code for those who prefer to scan — no customer is left out.
